newsitem.title: USA: OMB's Raines hopes for US budget deal by mid-April.
newsitem.headline: OMB's Raines hopes for US budget deal by mid-April.

text.p: Office of Management and Budget Director Franklin Raines said Wednesday he hoped the White House and Congress would reach a budget agreement by mid-April.

"I hope we have a budget deal this spring," Raines told reporters after testifying at a Joint Economic Committee hearing. Actual implementation of any budget deal would likely occur after Congress' August recess, he added.

"I hope we have a budget deal as soon as possible and I think if we were to work hard we could have a budget deal in time for the Congressional budget resolution adoption. That process gets kicked off around the middle of April," Raines said.
